//ChewingStick: The Harsh Wilds-owned tooth decay remedy (Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/afflictions.md sections 3.5 point 1, 6.2 and 6.3; the second tooth decay DECISION and the H&F cures DECISION), the second item to copy CardData/Item/hw_herbal_wash.json's shape. A CT0 consumable made by CardData/Blueprint/hw_bp_chewing_stick.json from a VANILLA card only (WillowTwigs), so the cure never needs another mod. BASE DOSE, the DismantleAction 'Chew': DaytimeCost 1, hw_teeth -HW_TEETH_STICK_STEP = 48 (half a band), and the card is used up (ReceivingCardChanges ModType 3). OPTIONAL STRONGER DOSE, the CardInteraction 'Chew with Herbs': a card dragged onto this one is accepted BY TAG, CompatibleCards TriggerTagsWarpData tag_Herb (TriggerTagsWarpType 3), never by UniqueID, and refused by NOTCompatibleCards TriggerTagsWarpData tag_Poisonous (TriggerTagsWarpType 3), exactly as hw_herbal_wash does it (read its note: InGameCardBase offers an interaction only when the dragged card fails NOTCompatibleCards and passes CompatibleCards; neither tag is a vanilla CardTag, WarpResolver creates each once by name, so today only Herbs and Fungi's leaf, flower and root herbs carry tag_Herb, and with that mod absent no card carries it and the interaction is simply never offered). Both cards are used up (GivenCardChanges and ReceivingCardChanges ModType 3), DaytimeCost 1, hw_teeth -HW_TEETH_HERB_STEP = 96 (a full band); never StackCompatible (one herb, one dose). No BepInDependency on Herbs and Fungi and no Herbs and Fungi UniqueID anywhere in this mod (Development_Tools/Tests/HarshWilds-Afflictions.Tests.ps1 [no-hf-dependency] and [no-hf-uid]). Both writes to hw_teeth are multiples of 24 ([clamp-own]). Chewing does not touch Pain: vanilla willow bark is the painkiller and this is the cure. The card image is HarshWilds/Resource/Picture/hw_chewing_stick.png (provenance in HarshWilds/.art/hw_chewing_stick.json), and the blueprint shares it. Every number is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER, session-inferred and unmeasured against play (harness probe P7 shape for the drag).

CardDescription.DefaultText: A willow twig with one end chewed into a brush. Chewed on, it scrubs the teeth and wears the rot of tooth decay down a little at a time, but it is used up. With Herbs and Fungi installed, a herb dragged onto it makes a stronger dose.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Chew the stick and scrub your teeth with it to wear down tooth decay.
Work the herb into the chewed end and scrub your teeth with it: a stronger dose against tooth decay.
